lesson_title: Longitudinal System Identification from Skywalker X8 UAV Flight Tests
scope_guardrail: The two MIT rasters are contextual evidence from a different perching-glider campaign. All computed coefficients, predictions, residuals, metrics, and ACF values belong exclusively to the CC0 Skywalker X8 Version 1.0 dataset. No figure may visually imply that the X8 computation used, reproduced, digitized, or validated the MIT maneuver.

format_decisions.reason: It is a short-label block protocol and course.yaml requires the file-based key_image figures/time-ordered-holdout.svg. This deliberately supersedes the older component target in asset-preflight.json.

The comparison combines responsive text, two maneuver cards, multiple line/ACF plots, units, and metric labels. A generated typed data module keeps every plotted value tied to the audited artifacts while the component supplies accessible layout and KaTeX-capable labels. The visible and code-facing name is changed from GliderResidualDiagnostics to X8ValidationDiagnostics to remove the obsolete vehicle implication.

The pipeline needs several sentence-length labels, unit-bound signal names, a no-feedback boundary, and responsive card layout; it is explanatory and contains no measured-looking trace or performance number.

figures.classification: rights-cleared deterministic recomputation from audited X8 data
figures.embed: <Figure name="X8ValidationDiagnostics" alt="Two validation-maneuver columns compare AR(2) and ARX one-step and free-run error traces and NRMSE, followed by ARX residual autocorrelation whose bars repeatedly cross per-file descriptive bands." caption="Elevator-aware ARX lowers error on both untouched X8 maneuvers, but autocorrelation beyond the descriptive bands leaves predictable structure in the residuals." />
generation_contract: The generator must verify all three pinned hashes before reading values and must fail closed on a mismatch.
Read all 874 scored rows; preserve file boundaries and every sample. Do not smooth, interpolate, resample, cherry-pick a window, or import any MIT pixel or former synthetic benchmark.
From the CSV export per-file arrays for t_s, arx_one_step_residual_rad_s, ar2_one_step_residual_rad_s, arx_free_run_error_rad_s, and ar2_free_run_error_rad_s.

From validation-summary.json export only the audited per-file RMSE/NRMSE, macro NRMSE effects, ACF lags 1-20, per-file descriptive bands, scored counts, decision wording, DOI/version/license, and full provenance hashes.
Serialize one deterministic typed TypeScript module in fixed file order 3211_5 then doublet_4 with full float strings and a generated-from header. A second run must be byte-identical.
The component imports only the generated module and palette constants; it performs coordinate mapping for display but no metric recomputation or model fitting.
figures.layout: A responsive two-card grid, one card for 3211_5 and one for doublet_4. Each card contains a compact NRMSE comparison header, a one-step residual strip, a free-run error strip, and an ARX one-step ACF stem plot. Beneath the cards, two macro-effect badges lead to the adequacy statement.

figures.alt: Two validation-maneuver columns compare AR(2) and ARX one-step and free-run error traces and NRMSE, followed by ARX residual autocorrelation whose bars repeatedly cross per-file descriptive bands.
figures.caption: Elevator-aware ARX lowers error on both untouched X8 maneuvers, but autocorrelation beyond the descriptive bands leaves predictable structure in the residuals.
figures.acceptance: The two maneuver cards remain visually separate; no path joins their end points. Both modes and models are labeled, all axis units are visible, macro numbers exactly match the audited summary, lag bands are per-file rather than pooled, and the final wording is 'predictively better but structurally incomplete.' At 320-360 px the cards stack and legends, numbers, and ACF crossings remain readable without horizontal scrolling.
figures.rights_and_credit: Underlying observations are CC0-1.0. As a code-native derived component it needs no raster credits.yaml entry, but the DOI/version/license line stays inside the figure and the dataset citation stays in lesson References. Full file IDs/MD5s and protocol/script/output hashes remain in the generated module header and build records, not in a caption wall.

calling either validation maneuver perching, stall, or a final 20% block

figures.embed: <Figure name="X8IdentificationPipeline" alt="A five-stage Skywalker X8 pipeline carries the physical aircraft and strong-wind disturbance into synchronized 40 hertz elevator and pitch-rate records, training-only fitting, frozen AR and ARX predictors, and two separately reset validation maneuvers, with validation feedback blocked." caption="The X8 audit permits training files to freeze the recurrence, then sends two separately reset maneuvers forward to one-step and free-run checks; validation never flows back." />
figures.layout: Three responsive numbered cards preserve reading order without tiny type: (1) physical X8 and recorded channels, (2) training-only integrity/fitting and freeze, (3) separate validation predictions and residual diagnosis. Short rightward arrows connect cards on wide layouts; on narrow layouts cards stack by number and the no-return rule remains a full-width strip.
exact_labels: NO RETURN: validation cannot tune preprocessing, order, lag, coefficients, or plot windows
manual synchronization prevents exact actuator-delay inference

graphic_rules: Use a generic fixed-wing silhouette or minimal wing symbol only; do not reproduce either MIT aircraft or imply an X8 photograph.
Use abstract sample ticks, channel names, and cards; no invented measured trace or validation number.
Bind amber to elevator u and blue to pitch rate q everywhere they appear, including KaTeX labels.
Arrows point only right in wide layout. The validation no-return strip terminates at the freeze gate and never points into training choices.
Place the wind disturbance before sensing and the manual-sync warning at the record-to-model seam; do not label either as an estimated effect.

global_render_and_accessibility_criteria: All five figures express one idea each and appear immediately after the sentence their caption resolves.
Every alt is one factual sentence; captions state the takeaway and never carry a license wall or hidden numeric claim.
House visuals use system-ui, currentColor, palette constants, at most amber and blue plus currentColor, and no Tailwind inside component figures.
Every color role is also named by text/legend, so no comparison depends on color alone.
Raw SVG has no fixed width/height. Components are pure, hook-free, client-free, use inline styles, and remain legible within the site's max-w-2xl container.
Inspect every authored figure after rendering, repeat until a pass finds zero clipping, collision, broken math, ambiguous arrow, unreadable label, or dark-theme defect.
Inspect sourced rasters against every line of the sourced-image checklist and inspect the final chapter rather than relying on file-level checks alone.
At approximately 320-360 px width, component cards stack without horizontal scroll; raw-SVG text remains readable; rasters scale proportionally and retain lightbox access.
Run npm run preview -- digital-signal-processing perching-glider-system-identification and inspect lesson plus figures-only light/dark outputs.
Run npm run validate -- digital-signal-processing perching-glider-system-identification with zero errors, then npx tsc --noEmit and npx eslint components/figures after component registration.
source_and_data_separation_test: The first two captions contain MIT/perching and explicitly say different vehicle or not X8.
The last three visuals contain Skywalker X8 labels and no MIT pixels.
Only X8ValidationDiagnostics contains computed traces or numeric outcomes, and its generated module verifies the audited CSV/summary hashes before generation.
TimeOrderedHoldout and X8IdentificationPipeline contain abstract blocks/ticks only and cannot be mistaken for measurements.
No visual labels a validation file as stall, perching, final 20%, or an exact actuator-delay experiment.
